units: logical pixels; physical pixels depend on OS DPI and session zoom

font_roles.windows_preferred: Segoe UI from the installed OS; never redistributed
font_roles.linux_fallback: DejaVu Sans from the installed OS

content_colors.owned_by: the document/editor format and theme, never inherited from shell colors

focus.keyboard_order: menu, navigation, current page controls; Shift+Tab reverses

reference_status: owner-directed provisional density; not pixel-measured Office 2024 Start/Backstage acceptance

behavior.cards: 1, 2 or 3 fixed-width columns according to available content width; vertical scrolling
behavior.navigation: Home/New/Open/Recent at top; Settings/About in footer; compact header spacing at short heights
behavior.recent_files: actual stored records, case-insensitive filename/path filter, single-line ellipsis with full-path tooltip
behavior.open: location pane beside recent files, stacked below 620 logical content pixels
